principle.id: Nilai menilai proses, bukan untung atau rugi. Proses yang benar tetap bernilai baik walaupun kena SL; proses yang salah tidak mendapat nilai tambahan karena kebetulan untung.
principle.en: The score judges the process, never the profit or loss. A sound process still scores well when it hits the SL; a poor one earns nothing extra for a lucky profit.

risk.measure: risk_pct = |entry − SL| in pips × pip value per lot (USD) × lot ÷ balance × 100

volatility_part.measure: sl_atr = |entry − SL| ÷ ATR(14) at Start (key: numbers.atr14_pips)

bonus.when: SL beyond numbers.invalidation_level (or no level given)

reasons.rule: 6 × (valid reasons chosen ÷ reasons chosen); 0 with no reason

cases.case: ran to SL, TP or the window's auto-close
manual close with a valid close reason (structure_broken, news_ahead, target_area)
manual close before the target without a valid reason (small_profit, bored)
panic close near the SL without a new signal (fear)

scenario_no_trade.rule: When decision.ideal is no_trade the whole score is decision and reasons.

pending_unfilled.rule: A pending order that never fills is scored on the decision only: decision points × 5 (out of 100); lot, SL and TP aren't scored.

mcq_complex.rule: Per option: +1 ÷ k for each right option chosen, −1 ÷ k for each wrong option chosen (k = number of right options); floor 0, max 1.

report.id: Hasil akhir berupa umpan balik per aspek (risiko, SL, TP/R:R, keputusan, manajemen posisi) dan level Learn 101 yang perlu diulang, dihitung dari soal PG yang salah per level. Tanpa peringkat dan tanpa perbandingan antar pengguna.
report.en: The result is feedback per aspect (risk, SL, TP/R:R, decision, position management) and the Learn 101 levels to revisit, from the wrong answers per level. No ranking and no comparison between users.

name.id: Aksi jual besar pasar global ("Black Monday" 2015)

decision.id: ATR M15 jauh di atas normal, harga melompat tajam, dan struktur M15 campuran karena gerak bolak-balik yang besar. SL yang menghormati volatilitas ini menuntut lot sangat kecil, sementara spread dan slippage bisa membesar. Level 3 menyebut volatilitas mendadak sebagai penyebab drawdown tinggi; NO TRADE adalah pilihan yang tepat.
decision.en: The M15 ATR is far above normal, price is jumping sharply, and the M15 structure is mixed because of the big back-and-forth swings. An SL that respects this volatility needs a tiny lot, while spreads and slippage can widen. Level 3 names sudden volatility as a cause of high drawdowns; NO TRADE is the right call.

decision.id: Risiko geopolitik seperti ini tidak ada di kalender dan bisa mengubah sentimen dalam sekejap (Level 5). decision.en: Geopolitical risk like this isn't on any calendar and can flip sentiment in an instant (Level 5). The M15 structure is mixed, so there's no clear directional edge, and EUR/JPY is sensitive to panic because the yen is seen as a safe haven. Holding back until things are clearer is a valid decision.

Skipping is right too if your SL is much wider than the structure.

e.en: An example rule from the lesson.

a.en: The ideal number is set by the signals.

d.en: The costs pile up with the number of trades.

explanation.id: Tumpang tindih sesi London dan New York biasanya jendela paling ramai; jamnya bergeser sekitar satu jam saat DST.
explanation.en: The London–New York overlap is usually the busiest window; the times shift by about an hour with DST.

explanation.id: Standard 1,00 lot = 100.000 unit base; mini 0,10 = 10.000; micro 0,01 = 1.000.
explanation.en: Standard 1.00 lot = 100,000 base units; mini 0.10 = 10,000; micro 0.01 = 1,000.

explanation.id: Angka terakhir adalah pipette; yang dihitung 1 pip adalah angka sebelumnya.
explanation.en: The last digit is the pipette; what counts as 1 pip is the digit before it.

explanation.id: CHoCH adalah close melewati swing penting berlawanan arah tren; itu peringatan, bukan perintah jual.
explanation.en: A CHoCH is a close through a key swing against the trend; it's a warning, not an order to sell.

explanation.id: Kalau dua timeframe bertentangan, timeframe besar menang.
explanation.en: When two timeframes disagree, the bigger one wins.

explanation.id: Marubozu memiliki badan penuh dengan sedikit atau tanpa bayangan dan menunjukkan kekuatan yang signifikan.
explanation.en: A marubozu has a full body with little or no shadow and shows significant strength.

explanation.id: Leverage hanya menurunkan jaminan (margin) yang dibutuhkan.
explanation.en: Leverage only lowers the collateral (margin) required.

explanation.id: 2% × $3.000 = $60. Risiko diukur dalam uang, bukan pip.
explanation.en: 2% × $3,000 = $60. Risk is measured in money, not pips.

explanation.id: Cek struktur: selama HL terakhir bertahan, penurunan di uptrend masih pullback.
explanation.en: Check the structure: while the last HL holds, a dip in an uptrend is still a pullback.

explanation.id: 2,5% − 4% = −1,5%: bunga tinggi bukan alasan yang cukup.
explanation.en: 2.5% − 4% = −1.5%: a high rate isn't reason enough.

explanation.id: "Lebih baik" bergantung pada jenis data: pengangguran lebih tinggi berarti pasar kerja lebih lemah.
explanation.en: "Better" depends on the kind of data: higher unemployment means a weaker job market.

explanation.id: Daftar periksa, jeda, dan batas harian adalah alat untuk memanggil Sistem 2 sebelum uang bergerak.
explanation.en: Checklists, pauses and daily limits are tools to bring in System 2 before money moves.

explanation.id: Profit factor = total R menang ÷ total R kalah = 9 ÷ 6 = 1,5.
explanation.en: Profit factor = total R won ÷ total R lost = 9 ÷ 6 = 1.5.
